bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
expected=9cfd59bf11b3b813c44aed94926456669f4c7bfb
test "$(git -C "$r/.worktrees/room-public-buttons-9cfd59b" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected" || { echo SOURCE_MISMATCH;exit 70; }
target=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-public-buttons-9cfd59b --format '{{.Id}}')
live=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
if test "$target" = "$live"; then echo ROOM_BUTTONS_IMAGE=DEPLOYED; else echo ROOM_BUTTONS_IMAGE=NOT_DEPLOYED; fi
if test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true; then echo GAYBBS_RUNNING=YES; else echo GAYBBS_RUNNING=NO; fi
if docker logs --since 15m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then echo GAYBBS_BOT_READY_SEEN=YES; else echo GAYBBS_BOT_READY_SEEN=NO; fi
if test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true; then echo POSTGRES_RUNNING=YES; else echo POSTGRES_RUNNING=NO; fi
if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active; then echo USERBOT_ACTIVE=YES; else echo USERBOT_ACTIVE=NO; fi
echo ROOM_BUTTONS_READONLY_STATE_CHECK_COMPLETE
